title: Simulator paths
sub: Build reviewed, optional information journeys without storing a visitor’s answers.
createHint: Start with one question. You can add information and result steps on the canvas.
emptyHint: Create the first reviewed path. Drafts remain private until a separate publication review.
editor.graphHint: Add a step, write its content, then drag from a choice to the next step.
editor.saveError: Could not save the simulator draft
editor.selectNode: Select a step to edit its text, choices, and behavior.
editor.sourceSummaryHint: Explain who owns this path, what evidence supports it, and what it helps a visitor understand.
editor.removeStepHint: Connections to this step will also be removed.
editor.connectHint: Drag a choice connector to another step.
editor.nextStepHint: Pick an existing step, or create the next one from here.
script.toolbarHint: Write the whole path as text, then apply it to the map.
script.heading: Text checks
script.hint: One block per step. Applying replaces the draft map; nothing reaches the database until you save the draft.
script.applied: Text applied to the draft map
script.copyError: Could not copy the path text
script.readyToApply: No problems found. Apply to update the map.
script.inSync: The text matches the current draft map.
node.question: Question
node.keyHint: Stable lowercase identifier used when reviewing the flow.
node.noChoices: Add at least one short choice, then connect it to the next step.
validation.heading: Readiness
validation.hint: These checks protect visitors from dead ends. Publication review remains a separate step.
publication.publishHint: The structure is ready. Publishing makes this exact version available without an account.
publication.saveFirst: Save the latest changes before publishing.
publication.structureGate: Resolve the readiness checks before publishing.
publication.demoGate: Demo or fictional content cannot be published. Use the private visitor preview to test it.
publication.publishDescription: Confirm that the source, review dates, result guidance and safety disclaimers have been reviewed. This exact version will become anonymously accessible.
publication.publishError: Could not publish the simulator path
publication.unpublishTitle: Remove this simulator from the public site?
publication.unpublishDescription: The public URL will stop working. The immutable version and audit history will remain available in the workspace.
publication.unpublishError: Could not unpublish the simulator path
mobile.canvasNotice: The visual map is available on wider screens. On this device, reorder and edit steps from the outline.
list.noResults: No simulator paths match these filters.
list.deleteDescription: “{title}” will be removed from active work and from the public site if published. Its version and audit history remain recoverable.
list.deleteError: Could not delete the simulator path
create.intro: Define the path’s responsibility and first question. The remaining branches are built after creation.
create.ownershipHint: Identify who is responsible for the facts and where this journey applies.
create.contentHint: Write the first decision in plain language. Visitors may skip it.
create.reviewHint: A simulator must have a traceable purpose and a scheduled accuracy review.
initialPromptPlaceholder: What do you need help with today?
initialExplanationPlaceholder: Choose the answer that is closest. You can skip this question.
translation.heading: Languages and translation
translation.hint: The source graph is versioned. Translation requests are pinned to the exact graph the translator received.
translation.requestHint: The translator receives a secure, expiring link and only the simulator text.
translation.name: Translator name
translation.reviewHint: Accepting promotes this text into the current draft. Rejecting keeps it private.
archiveHint: Archived paths stay private and can be restored.
